pages.title: Chug Wagon
pages.text: Guitarists call a palm-muted riff a "chug," and that's the sound of the guitar sample in Chug Wagon. The song plays in Washington, D.C., the seventh race in Skitchin', a 5.9-mile course whose password is CAPITAL.

pages.title: Toning down the violence
pages.text: In December 1993, the US Senate held hearings on violent video games, and EA toned down the violence in Skitchin' several times. Designer Dave Warfield says that if the game had gone through Nintendo, "I'm pretty sure we wouldn't have passed."
